title: Bulk Phase Transition and Edge Behavior in Temporally Correlated Random Matrices
abstract: arXiv:2608.23944v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study long-range correlated Wigner-type matrices built from row-independent stationary Gaussian sequences. For exponentially decaying (AR(1)) correlations, the bulk spectral density deforms from the semicircle law via an explicit combinatorial "hub" mechanism, yet we verify the flatness and decay hypotheses of the matrix-Dyson-equation framework (MDE), with numerical evidence supporting Tracy-Widom edge universality for every fixed $\rho<1$ of the exponential decay correlations; the degenerate limit $\rho\to1^-$ reduces to a symmetrized Volterra operator, connecting to the singular-value cascade identified in a companion BBP analysis. For power-law correlations $dt\sim t^{-\gamma}$, we identify $\gamma_c=1/2$ as the critical point for divergence of the bulk fourth-moment, while $\gamma=1$ marks the breakdown of the flatness condition governing the MDE edge analysis. translated_title: 时间相关随机矩阵中的体相变与边缘行为
translated_abstract: 摘要：我们研究了由行独立平稳高斯序列构建的长程相关Wigner型矩阵。对于指数衰减（AR(1)）相关，体谱密度通过一个显式的组合“枢纽”机制从半圆律变形，但我们验证了矩阵Dyson方程框架（MDE）的平坦性和衰减假设，数值证据支持对于每个固定的指数衰减相关的$\rho<1$，Tracy-Widom边缘普适性；退化极限$\rho\to1^-$简化为一个对称化的Volterra算子，与伴随BBP分析中识别的奇异值级联相关联。对于幂律相关$dt\sim t^{-\gamma}$，我们确定$\gamma_c=1/2$为体四阶矩发散的关键点，而$\gamma=1$标志着控制MDE边缘分析的平坦性条件的失效。我们精确证明了四阶矩转变，并通过数值方法发现。
tldr: 本文揭示了时间相关随机矩阵中体相变和边缘行为的临界条件，并证明了四阶矩转变的精确结果。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals critical conditions for bulk phase transitions and edge behavior in temporally correlated random matrices, and proves the exact fourth-moment transition.
